summary.text: Bill Magnarelli represents the 129th Assembly District, which covers parts of the City of Syracuse and the Towns of Geddes and Van Buren, and first won election in 1998.
His official biography describes him as chairman of the Assembly Transportation Committee and a sponsor of the statewide Amber Alert law.

paragraphs.text: Magnarelli grew up in Syracuse, attended Syracuse University, where he majored in history, and graduated from Syracuse University Law School with honors in 1973, according to his Assembly biography.
He then served six years in the Army Reserves, rising to the rank of Captain.

The biography says he secured funding for the Syracuse Center of Excellence and the Syracuse University Connective Corridor, helped establish the "Say Yes to Education" program in Syracuse, and sponsored legislation creating the Syracuse Joint Schools Construction Board.
It credits him as sponsor of the Amber Alert law passed in 2002, "Tiffany's Law" on repeat DWI offenders piloting boats, and "Peter Falk's Law" on adult children visiting ill parents.
In addition to Transportation, he sits on the Economic Development and Education Committees, and his wife, Karen, died in 2017, per the biography.
